derivation.behavior: Aria2 reconciliation handles daemon restart, missing task and offline completion.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go compares DB ownership with daemon runtime/task state and reconciles without stale authority.

invariants: Reconciliation compares the current durable ownership tuple against one daemon snapshot and never trusts GID alone.
Missing, removed, errored, paused, active, completed, and runtime-replaced tasks have explicit outcomes.
Offline completion is accepted only for the current generation and exact runtime/GID ownership tuple.
Runtime rebinding creates a fresh generation and closes the historical owner.
